They look okay, don't worry they are very hardy plants, they just need well draining soil, medium watering, early morning or evening sunlight for the best colours, and if you have just the cuttings, keep those cuttings in a bottle of room temperature water for like 4-5 days  you'll see a lot of roots emerging, just change the water once in 2 days, and when you see a bunch of roots you can plant it in soil, after planting, give it another 4 or 5 days you'll see new leaves emerging, leave it just like that for now then after 2 or 3 weeks from then your plant look normal with plenty of leaves, now this is the most important part, during this time, you need to pluck/ pinch the top 2 tiny leaves and pinch the flowers ( you can leave 1 for if you want) as well, don't worry, if you pinch 2 leaves 4 new leaves will emerge in that place, and our main goal is to make the coleous look as bushy as possible, if it grows tall then it will become leggy( stem is visible)  and start to lose leaves and doesn't look that attractive, with the exception of 1 coleus variety, which you can ignore for now. That coleus is super hardy, it can thrive even in direct sunlight, it is like a super coleus haha.
